decisions.reason: The candidate already has a message-43 INTRODUCE that records the 4.5 qt bowl capacity and the required smaller, thinner whisk; no additional or corrected MODIFY is needed.
The bowl-capacity decision motivates component sizing but does not change the existing mixing-quality or foam-consistency criteria.
Changing the recorded bowl capacity and requiring a smaller whisk does not alter the requirement to minimize splashing.
The mechanical bowl-capacity decision does not change the standard 120V wall-power requirement.
The source changes bowl and whisk sizing, not the required existence or detail level of the wiring plan.
The bowl-capacity and whisk-size decision has no effect on the beige primary color or green accents.
The exact 4.5 qt capacity does not change the independently established requirement that bowls be easy to remove and quick to swap.
The source confirms bowl capacity and changes whisk sizing but does not revise the enclosure thickness or maximum-size constraint.
The mechanical sizing change does not alter the DJ-turntable-inspired visual theme.
The source does not modify the requirement that the bottom bowl seal prevent liquid from reaching the electronics.
The requested component-size revision may inform CAD work but does not change the system-layout deliverable requirement itself.
The bowl-capacity and whisk-size decision does not revise the required open/close valve or tap actuation mechanism.
